'''2009 Dantooine Regionals Thomas Whaley DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whaley]] at [[2009 Dantooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Black Power
* '''Username:''' Thomas Whaley
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
